Talents.Name: Vault
Talents.Description: Climb low ledges. Hold toward one and Saud pulls himself up.

Talents.Name: DashLeap
Talents.Description: Your dodge dash carries you across broken ground.

Talents.Name: PowerKick
Talents.Description: Kicks tear steel shutters off their rails.

Talents.Name: Haymaker
Talents.Description: A loaded hook that punches through cracked masonry.

Talents.Name: HawkFist
Talents.Description: Your punches carry fire. Burns MP, and only punches — kicks stay cold.

Stages.Name: SouqAlDawar
Stages.Briefing: He asks where the hole is. Nobody understands the question. A crew leans on the traders. He steps in. It is the only thing he knows.
Stages.BriefingArabic: يسأل عن الحفرة، ولا أحد يفهم
Stages.Hint: Ask about the hole. Nobody looks up.

Stages.Name: BaytAlDarb
Stages.Briefing: Word travels. The striking house wants to see what the stranger can do. Six rounds. Then they hand him VAULT. He takes it for a way up.
Stages.Hint: Six rounds. They want to see him.

Stages.Name: MarsaAlFajr
Stages.Briefing: Dawn on the water. The stone is wet and the runners will not stand still. The next rung sits behind a fight. So will the one after.
Stages.BriefingArabic: فجر على الماء، وخصوم لا يثبتون
Stages.Hint: Dawn. Snatchers who will not stand still.

Stages.Name: AbrajAlMalih
Stages.Briefing: Night on the salt towers. This is a raid, not a patrol. He takes it tower by tower. He thinks he is working his way out.
Stages.Hint: Night. A raid, not a patrol.

Stages.Name: AlHilal
Stages.Briefing: AL-SAQR runs the neon crescent. He is all legs and no patience. He fell too, a long time ago. He says so once. Saud does not hear it.
Stages.BriefingArabic: الصقر سقط قبله، وكف عن السؤال

Stages.Name: JaziratAlHajar
Stages.Briefing: They fall back to the stone island. Grapplers hold the ruins. There is nowhere to run out here. That cuts both ways.
Stages.BriefingArabic: لا مهرب هنا، لا لهم ولا له

Stages.Name: AlTariqAlMasdud
Stages.Briefing: The road is dead. Trucks sit across both lanes and the sun is going down. It is not one fight. It is a queue of them. He takes his place in it.
Stages.Hint: The road is blocked. Walk it anyway.

Stages.Name: MukhayyamAlNiran
Stages.Briefing: Here they pick who fights for the belt. He was never on the list. He is now. The last wall gives him HAWK FIST, fire in his hands. West is the souq.
Stages.Hint: The contenders wait by the fires.

Stages.Name: AlHalqa
Stages.Briefing: The door off the souq opens to his new hands. It is not the way up. The house is full. It knows his name. AL-WAHSH waits in the far corner.
Stages.Hint: The door his hands fit. No way up.

Stages.Name: BilaNihaya
Stages.Briefing: No belt, no crowd, no end. Just the next wave.
Stages.BriefingArabic: لا حزام ولا جمهور ولا نهاية
Stages.Hint: No end. Just the next wave.

Sounds.Name: Whoosh_Light
Sounds.Description: Air moved by a jab or cross. Short, dry, no tail. The sound of missing.

Sounds.Name: Whoosh_Heavy
Sounds.Description: A hook, kick or knee cutting air. Lower and longer than the light one; the wind-up should be audible.

Sounds.Name: Hit_Light
Sounds.Description: Fist on body, jab or cross. A slap with weight behind it, not a movie punch. Dry.

Sounds.Name: Hit_Heavy
Sounds.Description: Hook, kick or knee landing. Deep, with a crack on top. This is the one the player waits for.

Sounds.Name: Hit_Knockdown
Sounds.Description: The blow that puts someone down. Heavier than Hit_Heavy and followed by the body hitting the ground.

Sounds.Name: Block
Sounds.Description: A strike caught on the forearms. Dull thud, muffled, no crack.

Sounds.Name: Parry
Sounds.Description: The perfect guard. Sharp and bright with a short ring -- it has to be unmistakable from Block, because it is the reward.

Sounds.Name: Rage
Sounds.Description: The finisher going off. Big, low, room-filling; the one sound allowed to be cinematic.

Sounds.Name: Hawk_Ignite
Sounds.Description: HAWK FIST lighting up: a whump of flame catching on a fist.

Sounds.Name: Hawk_Hit
Sounds.Description: A flaming punch landing. Hit_Heavy with a burst of fire over it.

Sounds.Name: KO
Sounds.Description: A fighter going down for good. Body on ground, then nothing. Not a crowd sound.

Sounds.Name: Boss_Enrage
Sounds.Description: A boss crossing into phase two. A roar, or a breath drawn -- it should make the player step back.

Sounds.Name: Dash
Sounds.Description: A dodge dash. Feet scraping and a short rush of cloth.

Sounds.Name: Dash_Leap
Sounds.Description: The dash once DASH LEAP is held: the same scrape, then a beat of nothing before the landing.

Sounds.Name: Footstep
Sounds.Description: One step on the stage floor. Fired from the walk animation's notify. Wide pitch range so a walk cycle never sounds looped.

Sounds.Name: Land
Sounds.Description: Feet hitting the ground after a leap or a knockback.

Sounds.Name: Gate_Strike
Sounds.Description: A strike landing on a shutter or a cracked wall that has not given yet. Metal or stone taking a hit and holding.

Sounds.Name: Gate_Break
Sounds.Description: The third strike: a shutter tearing off its rails, or masonry coming down. Debris after.

Sounds.Name: Gate_Open
Sounds.Description: A ledge climbed, a gap crossed, a locker opened -- the quiet gates. A latch, a scrape, a hand on stone.

Sounds.Name: Talent_Found
Sounds.Description: A talent picked up. The biggest UI sound in the game; the world just opened.

Sounds.Name: Exp_Cache
Sounds.Description: XP found behind a gate. Smaller than Talent_Found; a reward, not a milestone.

Sounds.Name: Exit_Travel
Sounds.Description: Walking out of an area into the next. A door, a step through, a breath of the new place.

Sounds.Name: Exit_Sealed
Sounds.Description: A route refusing you. Solid and final -- a bolt, a hand on a locked door. Pairs with the SEALED banner.

Sounds.Name: Wave_Start
Sounds.Description: An ambush closing in. Low, rising, short. The arena just locked.

Sounds.Name: Wave_Clear
Sounds.Description: The last of a wave down and the arena unlocking. A release, not a fanfare.

Sounds.Name: Stage_Clear
Sounds.Description: An area beaten. This one can be a fanfare.

Sounds.Name: Stage_Fail
Sounds.Description: Saud down. Low and slow; no sting.

Sounds.Name: Level_Up
Sounds.Description: A rank gained from fighting. Bright, short, upward.

Sounds.Name: Upgrade_Bought
Sounds.Description: XP spent at the training camp. A confirm with weight; money changing hands.

Sounds.Name: UI_Tap
Sounds.Description: Any button. Quiet, dry, instant.

Sounds.Name: UI_Back
Sounds.Description: Going back a screen. UI_Tap, lower.

Sounds.Name: UI_Denied
Sounds.Description: A button that will not: not enough XP, a locked mode. Short, flat, not rude.

Sounds.Name: Weapon_Pickup
Sounds.Description: A pipe, plank or crowbar picked up out of a smashed crate.

Sounds.Name: Weapon_Swing
Sounds.Description: An armed punch cutting air. Heavier than Whoosh_Heavy and with the object's own sound: pipe ring, plank whip.

Sounds.Name: Weapon_Hit
Sounds.Description: An armed punch landing. Steel or wood on body.

Sounds.Name: Weapon_Break
Sounds.Description: The last use spent: the plank splitting, the pipe clanging away.

Sounds.Name: Crate_Break
Sounds.Description: A crate or barrel giving way. Wood splintering, or a barrel's hollow clang.

Sounds.Name: Pickup_Health
Sounds.Description: The skewer. Warm, quick.

Sounds.Name: Pickup_Rage
Sounds.Description: The rage orb. A charge taken in; a little electric.

Sounds.Name: Music_Stage
Sounds.Description: The fight loop. One track per theme is the intent; start with one and cast per stage later.

Sounds.Name: Music_Menu
Sounds.Description: The title screen. Slower than the fight loop, same key.

Sounds.Name: Music_Boss
Sounds.Description: Every boss fight until a boss has a theme of his own (Music_Wahsh / Music_Saqr / Music_Zayos

Sounds.Name: Music_Under
Sounds.Description: Underground. The stage loop slowed and sunk: sub bass, a darbuka echoing in a cellar, no top end.

Sounds.Name: Music_Up
Sounds.Description: The roofs. The stage loop opened out: wind, wide reverb, oud and qanun high above the street.
